guarantees.claim: digest_size_started_q is synchronously set to SHA2_None when reset is active (rst_ni low), and to digest_size_started_d otherwise.
guarantees.cond: on every posedge clk_i or negedge rst_ni

assumptions.claim: rst_ni must be driven low (active-low reset assertion) to reliably initialize digest_size_started_q to SHA2_None.
assumptions.risk: if reset is not asserted, digest_size_started_q may power up with an undefined value, leading to unintended SHA mode selection and potentially incorrect HMAC operation.
